bb pool account — commands

Usage:

Commands:
  bb pool account list            List pool accounts and observed quota

Run `bb pool account <command> --help` for arguments and options.

bb pool account add — Sign in to Claude or Codex, import credentials, or add an Anthropic API key

Usage:
  bb pool account add --provider <claude|codex> [--login] [--import] [--api-key <value>] [--label <value>] [--priority <value>] [--json]

--login prints the browser or device step and exits; finish it with `bb pool account login-complete` (Claude) or `bb pool account login-poll` (Codex).
--import reads the provider's existing login on this bb server host (~/.claude or ~/.codex).

Options:
  --provider <claude|codex>  Provider this account belongs to
  --login                    Start a browser or device login
  --import                   Import this host's login
  --api-key <value>          Anthropic API key; prefer --api-key-stdin
  --label <value>            Label shown in listings
  --priority <value>         Failover position; lower numbers run first
  --json                     Emit JSON

bb pool account priority — Set an account's position in the failover order

Usage:
  bb pool account priority <id> <priority> [--json]

Arguments:
  <id>        Account UUID from `bb pool account list`
  <priority>  Lower runs first

Options:
  --json  Emit JSON

bb pool account login-complete — Complete a Claude browser login with its manual code

Usage:
  bb pool account login-complete --session <value> --code <value> [--json]

Options:
  --session <value>  Session ID printed by `bb pool account add --login`
  --code <value>     Code from the final login page; prefer --code-stdin
  --json             Emit JSON

bb pool config set — Set switchThreshold, the quota fraction at which accounts rotate

Usage:
  bb pool config set <key> <value> [--json]

Arguments:
  <key>    switchThreshold
  <value>  Above 0, at most 1

Options:
  --json  Emit JSON

bb pool config — Show Account Pooler configuration

Usage:
  bb pool config [--json]

Options:
  --json  Emit JSON

bb pool routing — Enable or disable pooled routing for one provider

Usage:
  bb pool routing <provider> [--off] [--json]

Arguments:
  <provider>  claude or codex

Options:
  --off   Disable instead of enable
  --json  Emit JSON
